summary: High-Trend International Group filed a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 2,307,700 Class A ordinary shares at $6.50 per share, raising approximately $13.95 million in net proceeds. The offering was priced at a 42.4% discount to the last reported sale price of $11.28 on May 12, 2026. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners acted as placement agent, receiving a 7.0% cash fee. The shares trade on Nasdaq under HTCO. This is an ordinary capital raise with no special-situation characteristics such as acquisition, restructuring, or going-private. The filing represents routine equity financing.
